  • Character: Princess Celestia — Sunset Shimmer was Celestia's student before fleeing through the mirror.

What is Sunset Shimmer?

Sunset Shimmer is the unicorn who flees through the mirror, first as a rival to Twilight, then as the redeemed lead of the Equestria Girls films.

Key threads lead to My Little Pony: Equestria Girls and Princess Celestia.
